description.zh:
WAF实例的ID。

> 您可以调用[DescribeInstance](~~433756~~)获取当前WAF实例的ID。
description.en:
The ID of the WAF instance.

> You can call [DescribeInstance](~~433756~~) to obtain the ID of the current WAF instance.

description.zh: 要查询的IP。您可以设置该参数，模糊查询已添加的IP黑名单。
description.en: The IP address to query. You can set this parameter to perform a fuzzy query on the added IP address blacklist.

description.zh:
设置排序属性，支持按照如下属性**倒序排列**。取值：

- **gmtModified**：表示按照修改时间排序。

- **ip**：表示按照IP排序。

- **templateId**：表示按照模板ID排序。

- **id**：表示按照主键排序。
description.en:
The property by which to sort the results in **descending order**. Valid values:

- **gmtModified**: sorts by modification time.

- **ip**: sorts by IP address.

- **templateId**: sorts by template ID.

- **id**: sorts by primary key.

description.zh: 分页查询时，返回第几页数据。默认值为**1**，表示返回第1页数据。
description.en: The page number. Default value: **1**, which indicates the first page.

description.zh: 分页查询时，每页包含多少条结果。默认值为**10**，表示每页包含10条结果。
description.en: The number of entries per page. Default value: **10**, which indicates 10 entries per page.

description.zh:
WAF实例所属地域。取值：

- **cn-hangzhou**：表示中国内地。

- **ap-southeast-1**：表示非中国内地。
description.en:
The region in which the WAF instance is deployed. Valid values:

- **cn-hangzhou**: the Chinese mainland.

- **ap-southeast-1**: regions outside the Chinese mainland.
The ID of the Alibaba Cloud resource group.
The ID of the IP address blacklist rule for critical event protection.
The ID of the critical event protection template.

title.zh: 分页查询重保防护IP黑名单

example.unifiedCli: aliyun waf-openapi describe-major-protection-black-ips --instance-id waf_cdnsdf30000 --template-id 5673 --rule-id 20013199 --ip-like 192.0.XX.XX --order-by gmtModified --page-number 1 --page-size 10 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --resource-manager-resource-group-id rg-acfm000q --api-version 2021-10-01 --region cn-hangzhou
